defects.title: Executable signer-first AI/ML protocol verification was missing
defects.observed_behavior: Prior PSTF evidence mapped criteria to placeholder tests only; no executable tests proved AI/ML command/result namespace inventory, read-model addressability, correlation tags, relay OK/CLOSED/AUTH/EOSE handling, or HTTP-polling avoidance.
defects.intended_behavior: Signer-first AI/ML protocol readiness requires deterministic event-driven tests and production code evidence for the declared event semantics, while respecting the repository guide that legacy custom ranges are migration-only at runtime.
defects.resolution: Added executable Go tests in internal/controlplane and internal/adapters/nostr; hardened ML model import direct handler to require a d tag before canonical failure publication; updated PSTF evidence on 2026-06-07.
